name: Pascal Hassenpflug
headline: Full-Stack Developer C# Angular Azure | Trilingual DE/FR/EN | Freelance
summary:
As a 15+ year long full-stack developer and project manager, I’m looking for the next role. Developer, product owner, architect, support or pre-sales engineer - my strengths are wherever the “human” meets the “technical”, be it in terms of requirements analysis, UX design, documentation or presentation.

Software development is my natural capacity, and the Microsoft stack (.NET, C#, SQL, also Angular) is what I’m most skilled in, but also greatly enjoy the processes of creating engagement and matching requirements. I'm comfortable with using AI to accelerate and improve results.

Having lived and worked across Germany and France, I bring an international mindset. I'm curious and open to move towards new technology trends such as large language models (LLM) in AI, or blockchain.

MBTI Type: INFP (Mediator: Systems thinking, long-term alignment, diplomacy and bridge-building).
